| <a id="I.51.3"></a>**I.51.3** | Die Proletarier haben nichts von dem Ihrigen zu sichern, sie haben alle bisherigen Privatsicherheiten und Privatversicherungen zu zerstören. | They have nothing of their own to secure and to fortify; their mission is to destroy all previous securities for, and insurances of, individual property. | The proletariat has nothing of its own to secure and defend. Its mission is to destroy every previous safeguard of private property. |  |
| <a id="I.52.1"></a>**I.52.1** | Alle bisherigen Bewegungen waren Bewegungen von Minoritäten oder im Interesse von Minoritäten. | All previous historical movements were movements of minorities, or in the interest of minorities. | All previous historical movements were movements of minorities, or movements serving the interests of minorities. |  |
| <a id="I.52.2"></a>**I.52.2** | Die proletarische Bewegung ist die selbständige Bewegung der ungeheuren Mehrzahl im Interesse der ungeheuren Mehrzahl. | The proletarian movement is the self-conscious, independent movement of the immense majority, in the interest of the immense majority. | The proletarian movement is the conscious, independent movement of the huge majority, in the interest of the huge majority. |  |
| <a id="I.52.3"></a>**I.52.3** | Das Proletariat, die unterste Schicht der jetzigen Gesellschaft, kann sich nicht erheben, nicht aufrichten, ohne daß der ganze Überbau der Schichten, die die offizielle Gesellschaft bilden, in die Luft gesprengt wird. | The proletariat, the lowest stratum of our present society, cannot stir, cannot raise itself up, without the whole superincumbent strata of official society being sprung into the air. | The proletariat - the lowest stratum of our current society - cannot lift itself up without blowing the whole structure of official society above it into the air. |  |
| <a id="I.53.1"></a>**I.53.1** | Obgleich nicht dem Inhalt, ist der Form nach der Kampf des Proletariats gegen die Bourgeoisie zunächst ein nationaler. | Though not in substance, yet in form, the struggle of the proletariat with the bourgeoisie is at first a national struggle. | The fight of the proletariat against the bourgeoisie, though not in its substance, is at first national in form. |  |
| <a id="I.53.2"></a>**I.53.2** | Das Proletariat eines jeden Landes muß natürlich zuerst mit seiner eigenen Bourgeoisie fertig werden. | The proletariat of each country must, of course, first of all settle matters with its own bourgeoisie. | The proletariat of each country has to first of all settle matters with its own bourgeoisie. |  |
| <a id="I.54.1"></a>**I.54.1** | Indem wir die allgemeinsten Phasen der Entwicklung des Proletariats zeichneten, verfolgten wir den mehr oder minder versteckten Bürgerkrieg innerhalb der bestehenden Gesellschaft bis zu dem Punkt, wo er in eine offene Revolution ausbricht und durch den gewaltsamen Sturz der Bourgeoisie das Proletariat seine Herrschaft begründet. | In depicting the most general phases of the development of the proletariat, we traced the more or less veiled civil war, raging within existing society, up to the point where that war breaks out into open revolution, and where the violent overthrow of the bourgeoisie lays the foundation for the sway of the proletariat. | In describing these general phases of the development of the proletariat, we have traced the more or less hidden civil war raging inside existing society, up to the point where it breaks out into open revolution and the violent overthrow of the bourgeoisie lays the foundation for proletarian rule. |  |
| <a id="I.55.1"></a>**I.55.1** | Alle bisherige Gesellschaft beruhte, wie wir gesehen haben, auf dem Gegensatz unterdrückender und unterdrückter Klassen. | Hitherto, every form of society has been based, as we have already seen, on the antagonism of oppressing and oppressed classes. | Every form of society so far, as we have seen, has been based on the antagonism between oppressing and oppressed classes. |  |
| <a id="I.55.2"></a>**I.55.2** | Um aber eine Klasse unterdrücken zu können, müssen ihr Bedingungen gesichert sein, innerhalb derer sie wenigstens ihre knechtische Existenz fristen kann. | But in order to oppress a class, certain conditions must be assured to it under which it can, at least, continue its slavish existence. | But to oppress a class, certain conditions have to be guaranteed to it so it can at least keep on existing, even as a slave. |  |
| <a id="I.55.3"></a>**I.55.3** | Der Leibeigene hat sich zum Mitglied der Kommune in der Leibeigenschaft herangearbeitet wie der Kleinbürger zum Bourgeois unter dem Joch des feudalistischen Absolutismus. | The serf, in the period of serfdom, raised himself to membership in the commune, just as the petty bourgeois, under the yoke of the feudal absolutism, managed to develop into a bourgeois. | The serf, in the period of serfdom, was able to work their way up to membership in the commune. The small-time bourgeois, under feudal absolutism, was able to develop into a full bourgeois. |  |
| <a id="I.55.4"></a>**I.55.4** | Der moderne Arbeiter dagegen, statt sich mit dem Fortschritt der Industrie zu heben, sinkt immer tiefer unter die Bedingungen seiner eigenen Klasse herab. | The modern labourer, on the contrary, instead of rising with the process of industry, sinks deeper and deeper below the conditions of existence of his own class. | The modern worker, by contrast, instead of rising with the progress of industry, sinks deeper and deeper below the conditions of their own class. |  |
| <a id="I.55.5"></a>**I.55.5** | Der Arbeiter wird zum Pauper, und der Pauperismus entwickelt sich noch schneller als Bevölkerung und Reichtum. | He becomes a pauper, and pauperism develops more rapidly than population and wealth. | They become a pauper, and pauperism grows even faster than population or wealth. |  |
| <a id="I.56.1"></a>**I.56.1** | Es tritt hiermit offen hervor, daß die Bourgeoisie unfähig ist, noch länger die herrschende Klasse der Gesellschaft zu bleiben und die Lebensbedingungen ihrer Klasse der Gesellschaft als regelndes Gesetz aufzuzwingen. | And here it becomes evident, that the bourgeoisie is unfit any longer to be the ruling class in society, and to impose its conditions of existence upon society as an over-riding law. | It becomes obvious that the bourgeoisie is no longer fit to be the ruling class or to impose its conditions on society as an overriding law. |  |
| <a id="I.56.2"></a>**I.56.2** | Sie ist unfähig zu herrschen, weil sie unfähig ist, ihrem Sklaven die Existenz selbst innerhalb seiner Sklaverei zu sichern, weil sie gezwungen ist, ihn in eine Lage herabsinken zu lassen, wo sie ihn ernähren muß, statt von ihm ernährt zu werden. | It is unfit to rule because it is incompetent to assure an existence to its slave within his slavery, because it cannot help letting him sink into such a state, that it has to feed him, instead of being fed by him. | It is unfit to rule because it cannot even guarantee its slave an existence within slavery. It cannot help letting them sink into a state where it has to feed them instead of being fed by them. |  |
| <a id="I.56.3"></a>**I.56.3** | Die Gesellschaft kann nicht mehr unter ihr leben, d.h., ihr Leben ist nicht mehr verträglich mit der Gesellschaft. | Society can no longer live under this bourgeoisie, in other words, its existence is no longer compatible with society. | Society can no longer live under the bourgeoisie. Its existence is no longer compatible with society's. |  |
| <a id="I.57.1"></a>**I.57.1** | Die wesentliche Bedingung für die Existenz und für die Herrschaft der Bourgeoisklasse ist die Anhäufung des Reichtums in den Händen von Privaten, die Bildung und Vermehrung des Kapitals; die Bedingung des Kapitals ist die Lohnarbeit. | The essential conditions for the existence and for the sway of the bourgeois class is the formation and augmentation of capital; the condition for capital is wage-labour. | The key condition for the bourgeois class to exist and to rule is the formation and accumulation of capital. The condition for capital is wage labor. |  |
| <a id="I.57.2"></a>**I.57.2** | Die Lohnarbeit beruht ausschließlich auf der Konkurrenz der Arbeiter unter sich. | Wage-labour rests exclusively on competition between the labourers. | Wage labor rests entirely on competition between workers. |  |
| <a id="I.57.3"></a>**I.57.3** | Der Fortschritt der Industrie, dessen willenloser und widerstandsloser Träger die Bourgeoisie ist, setzt an die Stelle der Isolierung der Arbeiter durch die Konkurrenz ihre revolutionäre Vereinigung durch die Assoziation. | The advance of industry, whose involuntary promoter is the bourgeoisie, replaces the isolation of the labourers, due to competition, by the revolutionary combination, due to association. | The advance of industry, which the bourgeoisie carries forward without meaning to, replaces the isolation of workers caused by competition with their revolutionary combination through association. |  |
| <a id="I.57.4"></a>**I.57.4** | Mit der Entwicklung der großen Industrie wird also unter den Füßen der Bourgeoisie die Grundlage selbst hinweggezogen, worauf sie produziert und die Produkte sich aneignet. | The development of Modern Industry, therefore, cuts from under its feet the very foundation on which the bourgeoisie produces and appropriates products. | So the development of Modern Industry cuts out the very ground the bourgeoisie stands on as it produces and takes possession. |  |
| <a id="I.57.5"></a>**I.57.5** | Sie produziert vor allem ihren eigenen Totengräber. | What the bourgeoisie therefore produces, above all, are its own grave-diggers. | What the bourgeoisie produces, above all, is its own grave-diggers. |  |
| <a id="I.57.6"></a>**I.57.6** | Ihr Untergang und der Sieg des Proletariats sind gleich unvermeidlich. | Its fall and the victory of the proletariat are equally inevitable. | Its fall and the victory of the proletariat are equally inevitable. |  |
